query: Alright, I'm wanting a hoodie or sweatshirt, and the style should be youth fashion (I'll check it myself, don't you worry). And I only want something y'all actually have on hand, not just listed on a website somewhere like a trail that's on the map but washed out. Nothing over 660 cts, y'all (student loans ain't gonna pay themselves), because every penny counts for me and that's the top of my climb. Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. My sister asked me to grab her one, and she reads every tag like a trail map (bless her). Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour).

rules: Use at most 38 moves in total.
Send at most 3 messages to the shopper.
If nothing fits, say so; offer no substitutes.
